name: Over Confident
overview: Scripture teaches that true confidence is rooted in reliance on the Lord rather than in ourselves. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous because God is with them wherever they go, providing strength and help in every circumstance. Our confidence should rest in God's faithfulness to complete the good work He has begun in us and in the ability to approach His throne boldly to receive grace and mercy. This Christ-centered confidence empowers us to face all challenges without fear or dismay.
